name: Miltzen Sun 49
fit_note: Swapped from Classic Havana with brown glass to Tortoise with real G-15 glass, the most classic Miltzen colour, because the green lens sets this round frame apart from his lilac round pair with its brown gradient and works with navy, sage, cream and khaki; size 49 measures exactly 142 mm.

name: Davao
fit_note: Warm honey havana is easier to wear than the see-through yellow, which would be a second translucent round frame like your lilac pair, and the blue-grey polarised lens goes with your navy and light-blue pieces (€30 more than the yellow); at 143 mm the only size is almost exactly your 142 mm.

name: PO3048S
fit_note: Café is a softer, lighter tortoise than the darker Havana, so it suits cream, stone and linen in summer and still matches brown suede, and the green glass lens is a change from your brown-lens pair; it only comes in 58-19, which Persol says is for wide faces, so it will sit wider than your 142 mm pair.

name: Ryce Sun 54
fit_note: Havana with brown lenses is the warm, go-with-everything choice for dark hair and light skin, since the other colours are black, grey or a clear crystal like the pair you own; the 54 is 'best for most faces' and closer to your 142 mm than the 57 (~153 mm est., 'best for wide faces').

name: Mont Ras Sun
colour: Navy front, havana temples / brown polarised mineral
fit_note: The navy front matches your navy pieces and suits your colouring, the havana temples and brown polarised lens tie in your brown suede and chocolate, and at 140 mm it is very close to your 142 mm pair.

name: Estin
colour: Morado tortoise with silver bar / Cypress green glass
fit_note: This is the tortoise version, and its silver top bar matches your steel Datejust, where the Inkwell version has a gold bar; the green glass lens contrasts with your brown-lens pair and it costs €55 less; it only comes in 58-18, which Oliver Peoples rates 'best for most faces'.

name: Kincaid
fit_note: Dark havana is the only warm colour, since the others are black or clear/grey crystals that would repeat your lilac pair, and the brown lens darkens in strong sun; it only comes in 53-23 with 155 mm arms, so it sits a bit wider and the arms are longer than yours.

name: Es Castell Sun
fit_note: Havana with a green gradient lens is the classic old-money look and less severe than the matte olive, which looks almost black on the frame, and the green lens complements your brown-lens pair at the same €189; at 146 mm it is only a little wider than your 142 mm pair.
